Math Formulas (Python)
GCD: math.gcd(a, b)
LCM: a * b // math.gcd(a, b)
Factorial: math.factorial(n)
nCr: math.comb(n, r)
nPr: math.perm(n, r)
Power/mod: pow(a, b, m) # a^b % m fast
Sqrt (int): math.isqrt(n)
Ceil div: -(-a // b) or (a + b - 1) // b
Sum 1..n: n*(n+1)//2
Is prime (basic): trial divide up to isqrt(n)

return lo # smallest feasible x

Bit Manipulation
Check bit i: n & (1 << i)
Set bit i: n |= (1 << i)
Clear bit i: n &= ~(1 << i)
Toggle bit i: n ^= (1 << i)
Count set bits: bin(n).count('1')
Is power of 2: n > 0 and (n & (n-1)) == 0
XOR swap-free trick: find single non-dup via XOR of all
